description: This file contains implementations of optimization passes for the Torch JIT compiler, specifically for concatenation operations such as common input elimination, expansion, and combining concatenation nodes within computational graphs.

classes.name: ConcatCommonInputsEliminator
classes.description: Class implementing the logic to eliminate common inputs in concatenation operations within a computational graph.

classes.name: ConcatExpander
classes.description: Class responsible for expanding concatenation nodes into multiple copy operations and reusing buffers.

classes.name: ConcatCombiner
classes.description: Class that identifies and combines consecutive concatenation nodes to optimize graph structure.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the optimization pass for eliminating common concat inputs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the expansion of concat nodes into copy operations and buffer reuse.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the combination of consecutive concat nodes to reduce redundancy.

methods.name: handleBlock
methods.description: Recursively processes a block of nodes in the graph.

methods.name: handleCat
methods.description: Handles a concat node for common input elimination.

methods.name: postprocess
methods.description: Replaces marked nodes with optimized versions after processing.

methods.name: getOrCreateAliasDb
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the alias analysis database for the graph.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the concatenation expansion and redundancy elimination.

methods.name: determineUsageIdx
methods.description: Determines the index of a value in a node's inputs.

methods.name: getConcatInputs
methods.description: Retrieves the list of inputs for a concat node.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the concat node combination optimization.

methods.name: handleConcat
methods.description: Handles a concat node for potential merging with other concat nodes.

methods.name: collectOptimizableConcats
methods.description: Collects concat nodes that can be optimized by merging.

methods.name: createListConstruct
methods.description: Creates a new list construct node with specified inputs.

methods.name: combineConcats
methods.description: Performs the merging of compatible concat nodes.

methods.name: moveBefore
methods.description: Moves a node before another node in the graph.

methods.name: reuseBuffersInCopies
methods.description: Reuses buffers in copy operations to optimize memory usage.
